title: TP-Link router LAN 1 to NETGEAR switch port 3 (blue Ethernet cable)

spec.title: TP-Link router LAN 1 to NETGEAR switch port 3 (blue Ethernet cable)

devices.name: Router
devices.description: Black TP-Link Wi-Fi router: glossy black top with a white 'tp-link' logo, two black external antennas at the rear corners, a row of status LEDs along the front edge. Rear panel, left to right: round DC power jack, 'WPS/Reset' button, a silver-framed row of four Ethernet ports (labels 'LAN 2', 'LAN 3', 'LAN 4' printed under the right three), a blue USB port labelled 'USB', and a round 'Power' button.

devices.name: Switch
devices.description: Black NETGEAR desktop Ethernet switch: flat rectangular box with a white 'NETGEAR' wordmark on top. Front panel: green LED labelled 'Power' on the left, then a silver-framed row of five Ethernet ports numbered '1' to '5' underneath, each port with small LEDs at its upper corners.

requirements.text: The blue Ethernet cable must connect Router LAN 1 to Switch Port 3.
